interview.title: Voyager: From Analogue, to Digital, to Atmos
interview.subtitle: Super Progressive · SP014 · 5 October 2022 · 3:04:50
interview.detail: Justin Scott Dixon discusses his musical beginnings, the move to Orlando, early Cosmic productions and the evolution of Voyager. The interview preserves his firsthand recollections.
